heading_path: 223AA  Approved means of paying a fee
text: (1) For the purposes of subsection 223(2C), the Registrar may, by writing, determine one or more means for paying a fee. (2) The means may be an electronic means or any other means. (3) The Registrar must publish the determination in accordance with the regulations. (4) The Registrar may, in a determination under subsection (1), specify that one or more means for paying a fee are preferred means. Note: Under the regulations, the amount of a fee may be reduced for paying the fee by preferred means. (5) A determination under subsection (1) is not a legislative instrument.
